themes.title: Transnational Recalibration Following MAGA Midterm Defeats
themes.blurb: Democratic sweeping victories in the US midterm elections have sent shockwaves across international right-wing movements. Right-wing parties in Poland, Italy, Argentina, and Brazil are assessing their strategic alignment with Donald Trump, with some allies maintaining solidarity while others reframe the defeat or assert independent positioning.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: State judiciaries and legal institutions continue to challenge far-right leaders and parties through constitutional reviews, supreme court dismissals, and law enforcement interventions. From Brazil's Supreme Court restricting Bolsonarists to Poland's ongoing constitutional tribunal dispute, legal friction remains a major cross-border dynamic.
